title: Baltic nations successfully switch to European power grid after severing energy ties to Russia
description: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania stopped purchases of power from Russia after invasion of Ukraine

title: Russia’s shrinking world: The war in Ukraine and Moscow’s global reach
description: With its focus on war with its neighbor, Russia has taken its eyes off the ball elsewhere. As a result, its position is much weaker – but Putin remains dangerous.

title: Ukraine-Russia war latest: Ukraine 'launches three attacks' in Russian region; Trump says Putin 'wants dying to stop'
description: After growing noise around Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin potentially speaking, the US president has revealed they have had a call - though he wouldn't say how many. Meanwhile, fighting appears to have escalated in the Russian region of Kursk. Follow the latest on the Ukraine war.

title: Ukraine-Russia war latest: Donald Trump says Vladimir Putin wants dying to stop - as he reveals he's spoken with Russian leader
description: After growing noise around Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin potentially speaking, the US president has revealed he has had a call with the Russian leader - though he wouldn't say how many. He spoke as Ukraine reported another drone attack. Follow the latest on the Ukraine war.

title: In Ukraine, expect to see more ground drones on the battlefield to keep soldiers safe
description: Ukraine has been throwing everything it can at Russia as its all-out invasion nears the three-year mark. The latest weapon in the military's arsenal? Ground drones.

title: Trump says he’s spoken with Putin as Russia’s war in Ukraine approaches third anniversary
description: President Donald Trump announced in an interview published Saturday that he has spoken with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

title: Ukraine war briefing: Kim Jong-un vows ongoing support for Russia’s ‘just cause’
description: North Korean leader also pledged further development of nuclear forces; UK foreign secretary says no imminent peace talks with Russia. What we know on day 1,082

title: Trump Says He Spoke To Russia's Putin, Says He Wants To 'See People Stop Dying' In Ukraine
description: Trump has repeatedly emphasised that the war would have never taken place if he was President and vowed to bring a quick end to fighting. Russia and Ukraine have also signalled willingness for talks.

title: Mystery Surrounds Damage to Russian Baltic Sea Cable
description: A Russian Baltic Sea telecoms cable was damaged, allegedly by external impact, according to Rostelecom. Restoration work is ongoing with no subscriber impact. The incident is part of a trend of outages in the region, ambiguously linked to ongoing geopolitical tensions, exacerbated by Russia's Ukraine invasion.

description: 12 Indians are confirmed to have died while fighting for Russia. Read more at straitstimes.com.
